description.value:
Targets 2 unwilling creatures, the second adjacent to the first

Saving Throw Will vs. your class DC, rolled separately for each target

Forced Passage reaches two. The second target must be adjacent to the first. Each target attempts its own Will save against your class DC and the results do not affect one another. The attempt costs one threshold more than a single Forced Passage would, and you pay that cost whether either target is ferried or both resist — the door was opened twice regardless of who went through it.

cinderfall.incomplete: Ashcantor's entire signature resource system (Passage, a Passing, Walking Through, Embers, Ash-Light) has zero rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus -- the class card itself (classes.ashcantor.json) ships system.rules: [], and no abilities/ or class-features/ card exists to hold a Passage/Ember mechanic either. Checked pf2e's own generic SpecialResource rule element (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/special-resource.ts:24-247) as a possible fit: every real user (Alchemist's Versatile Vials, Gunslinger's Munitions Machinist, Fumbus's iconic feats) is a daily-refilling consumable counter, never a one-way permanent-increase track like Passage -- no real class resource matches Passage's shape, so there is no base mechanic here to extend or modify. This is a child of "Forced Passage," granted by The Pyre (ashcantor.the-pyre.json), whose own system.rules is [] -- Forced Passage itself has no Will-save-vs-class-DC rule element or target selector to extend to a second target.
